autograph hunter and accountant

He extracted autographs from Hardy and Swinburne using the same technique.[Collected Letters of Thomas Hardy, VII, 105 and The Swinburne Letters, V, 231; birth and death registers; listed at 24 Cramer Terrace, Gateshead on Tyne, in 1891 census]
